identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a 'Swiss & High-Contrast' academic platform that feels authoritative yet modern. Break the 'boring admin panel' stereotype with Bento grids, subtle noise textures, and deep purposeful typography.
anti_patterns: No default Inter font for headings.
No pure white (#ffffff) backgrounds without texture or subtle off-white tint.

primary.description: Deep Oxford Blue - The anchor of authority.

secondary.description: Paper White / Slate 100 - Backgrounds and panels.

accent.description: Royal Blue - Primary actions and active states.

texture.usage: Overlay on solid backgrounds to reduce digital flatness.

dashboard_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6 md:p-8
dashboard_grid.logic: 12-column system. Widgets span 3, 4, 6, or 8 columns. Full height children.

containers.card: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

Button.style: h-10 px-6 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all active:scale-95

variants.outline: border-2 border-slate-200 bg-transparent hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700

Card.style: rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm overflow-hidden

Input.style: h-11 rounded-lg border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all

Sidebar.style: w-64 border-r border-slate-200 bg-white h-screen sticky top-0 flex flex-col p-4 shadow-[4px_0_24px_-12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]

login_bg.usage: Full screen background for Login/Register pages with overlay.

empty_files.usage: Empty state for Project Files or Header background.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use 'recharts' for data visualization.

rules: Text contrast must be WCAG AA compliant (4.5:1).
All images must have alt text.
Do not rely on color alone for status (use icons + color).

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL: `yarn add framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge` if not present.
SETUP: Add the Google Fonts import to `src/index.css`.
THEME: Configure `tailwind.config.js` to use the specific colors defined in `colors.palette`.
COMPONENT: Create a `Layout` component that handles the Sidebar + Main Content structure.
COMPONENT: Create a `StatCard` component for dashboards using the Bento Grid style.
PAGE: Login page must use the `login_bg` image with a glassmorphism card for the form.
CRITICAL: Do not use default HTML inputs. Use Shadcn `Input`, `Select`, `Textarea` styled with the guidelines.
CRITICAL: Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic (generic centered layouts, default blue).
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8, gap-8) than typical designs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover lift, focus ring, page transitions).
Use named exports for components, default exports for pages.
